before.problem_source: T4 baseline case T1-INC-14 is missed because a Markdown receipt without a SUMMARY-GUARD block skips silently.
before.severe_defect_miss: T1-INC-14 target 0/1 from measured baseline 1/1 missed.
before.primary_metric: Absent-block severe miss changes from 1/1 to 0/1.
before.e03_intent: Require rejection when the evidence Markdown has no receipt block, rather than silent success.

after.problem_source: T4 independently observes that the existing summary guard silently skips when a receipt block is absent. T7 isolates that observable guard behavior from T1-INC-14's legal execution-chat metering UNRESOLVED.
after.severe_defect_miss: Required-receipt missing-block behavioral case may count as a repair only when an executable registered candidate operation produces explicit BLOCK. The legal T1-INC-14 UNRESOLVED is excluded from the denominator and must never be converted into a severe defect.
after.primary_metric: Paired replay must distinguish (a) missing required evidence, which is an evidence-completeness defect, from (b) legitimately unmeterable evidence, which remains UNRESOLVED. A repair is countable only for (a) when an authorized candidate operation executes.
after.e03_intent: Classify absence only when the contract states that a receipt block is required. Absence caused solely by a legitimately unmeterable quantity remains UNRESOLVED and must not be rejected as a severe defect.

t1_v3_applicability_resolution.reason: T1-INC-14 is an unverified inference about execution-chat token metering and is not usable as a failure-family anchor. The severe behavioral target is narrowed to the separately observed T4 summary-guard absence semantics. This does not relabel the token-metering incident and does not fill unavailable usage with zero.

classification_policy.condition: receipt block absent while the delivery contract explicitly requires it
classification_policy.expected_disposition: BLOCK if an authorized executable check rejects it
classification_policy.countable_as_repair: Only after actual paired candidate execution

classification_policy.condition: quantity is legitimately unmeterable and the source explicitly requires UNRESOLVED
classification_policy.expected_disposition: KEEP_UNRESOLVED; never severe defect and never automatic BLOCK

classification_policy.condition: receipt block present and hash matches
receipt block present and derived hash mismatches

evaluation_precondition_result.reason: T5 v3 is a closed three-operation registry and the absent-policy fixture/path is outside its declared enums. No operation extension is enabled or authorized in this task.
evaluation_precondition_result.forbidden_shortcut: Do not count FC_UNREGISTERED_OPERATION, FC_ARBITRARY_PATH, or a silent summary-guard rc=0 as detection of a severe defect.
